composites.name: poisson_baseline
composites.description: Steady Poisson solve validated vs analytic (MMS).

resolution.description: Mesh cells per side of the unit square

composites.name: high_order_verification
composites.description: High-order accuracy verification: a single (degree, resolution) point of the P1/P2/P3 optimal-L2-rate sweep on the smooth sin(pi*x)*sin(pi*y) manufactured solution.

resolution.description: Mesh cells per side of the unit square

composites.name: transient_diffusion
composites.description: Transient (backward-Euler) diffusion of a gaussian bump on the unit square.

resolution.description: Mesh cells per side of the unit square

composites.name: reaction_diffusion
composites.description: Fisher-KPP reaction-diffusion via DiffusionProcess ⊕ LogisticReactionProcess composition.

resolution.description: Mesh cells per side of the unit square

dt.description: Backward-Euler timestep size (shared by both processes)

composites.name: turing_patterns
composites.description: Gray-Scott Turing pattern formation: two DiffusionProcess instances (species U, V; Du != Dv) ⊕ one GrayScottReactionProcess composed through shared stores.

resolution.description: Mesh cells per side of the unit square

Du.description: Diffusion coefficient of species U (activator substrate)

Dv.description: Diffusion coefficient of species V (~half of Du -- differential diffusion drives the Turing instability)

dt.description: Backward-Euler timestep size (shared by both diffusion processes and the reaction)

composites.name: morphogen_gradient
composites.description: Source-Diffusion-Degradation (SDD) morphogen gradient: DiffusionProcess (Dirichlet source boundary c=c0) ⊕ LinearDegradationProcess composition; steady state c(x)=c0*exp(-x/lambda), lambda=sqrt(D/k).

c0.description: Morphogen concentration at the source boundary (x=0)

resolution.description: Mesh cells per side of the unit square

dt.description: Backward-Euler timestep size (shared by both processes)

composites.name: mesh_convergence
composites.description: Poisson L2 error vs mesh resolution -- FEM convergence (error ∝ h^(degree+1)).

resolution.description: Mesh cells per side of the unit square

composites.name: navier_stokes
composites.description: Incompressible lid-driven cavity flow (IPCS) -- velocity + pressure fields.

resolution.description: Mesh cells per side of the unit-square cavity

composites.name: vortex_street
composites.description: DFG 2D-2 benchmark -- incompressible flow past an off-center cylinder in a channel (real dolfinx IPCS on a gmsh-generated, cylinder-refined mesh); at Re=100 the wake sheds a von Karman vortex street with oscillating drag/lift.

dt.description: IPCS substep timestep size -- 0.0005, not the 0.001-0.002 that suffices for the lid-driven-cavity study: at this cylinder-refined mesh + Re=100, dt=0.001 (and even a skew-symmetric convection form at dt=0.001) went unstable (NaN) partway through the startup transient (~t=0.5s, confirmed empirically during development); dt=0.0005 does not.

h_cylinder.description: Mesh element size at the cylinder boundary (accuracy driver)

h_far.description: Mesh element size far from the cylinder (channel inlet/outlet/walls)

composites.name: porous_lattice
composites.description: Steady Stokes flow through a periodic circular-pillar lattice (real Taylor-Hood mixed dolfinx solve on a gmsh-generated porous microstructure) -- computes the effective (Darcy) permeability k_eff of the medium.

pillar_radius.description: Pillar disk radius (porosity-control knob; must be < half the lattice spacing)

h_pillar.description: Mesh element size at every pillar boundary (accuracy driver)

h_far.description: Mesh element size away from the pillars

pressure_drop.description: Prescribed pressure drop across the channel (inflow minus outflow)

composites.name: moving_boundary
composites.description: Diffusion on a deforming (ALE) domain with a prescribed moving boundary.

resolution.description: Mesh cells per side of the reference unit square

amplitude.description: Boundary oscillation amplitude, or growth rate for mode='grow'

omega.description: Angular frequency of the boundary oscillation (mode='oscillate')

dt.description: Backward-Euler substep size, also the mesh-motion substep size

composites.name: adaptive_refinement
composites.description: Residual-based adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) on the L-shaped domain's re-entrant-corner Laplace singularity -- Doerfler marking concentrates elements at the corner, recovering near-optimal O(dofs^-1/2) energy-norm convergence vs the O(dofs^-1/3) rate uniform refinement is capped at by the r^(2/3) corner singularity.

composites.name: peristalsis
composites.description: Peristaltic pumping: traveling-wave wall occlusion ⊕ ALE Navier-Stokes.

dt.description: Shared IPCS/mesh-motion substep size (also the tick interval)

ramp_time.description: Linear 0->amplitude ramp duration (avoids an impulsive-start instability)

L.description: Channel length (should be an integer multiple of wavelength)

nx.description: Mesh cells along the channel length

ny.description: Mesh cells across the channel height
